items.content: Agent-Reach public retrieval review (94f06c1969dfc1834001269d79d3ad0972d9dee6). RSS checks feedparser import: ImportError => off, other exceptions => error, success => ok; this file shows no fetch/parse body [S2]. Web check returns ok without network. Its read delegates URL normalization, calls Jina with a 30-second urlopen timeout argument, rejects responses over 5 MiB and detected challenges, decodes UTF-8 [S1]. YouTube probes yt-dlp --version: missing => off, other non-ok results => error; JS/config conditions can produce warn. After those gates, missing media tools for configured Whisper providers only change the ok message. Transcribe delegates; defaults are provider=auto and provider fallback disabled [S3]. Live channel retrieval and uninspected helpers remain unverified. Proposed next step: Core-owned Browser retrieval and typed RSS/Atom staging for read-only Research. Core retains network and cleanup authority; typed RSS/Atom and captions are not implemented by this workflow.
